name: Crystal growth
description: Growth of a single-crystal boule from melt or vapour (e.g. Czochralski or float-zone for silicon, physical vapour transport for SiC).
purpose: Produce defect-controlled single-crystal material of the required orientation, doping and diameter.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Ingot grinding & shaping
description: Cropping, cylindrical grinding and notch/flat forming of the as-grown ingot.
purpose: Bring the ingot to final diameter and mark crystal orientation.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer slicing (wire sawing)
description: Separation of the ingot into wafers, usually by multi-wire sawing; laser-based separation is also used for hard materials such as SiC.
purpose: Convert the ingot into wafers with minimum kerf loss and subsurface damage.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Lapping
description: Abrasive planarisation of both wafer faces after slicing.
purpose: Remove saw damage and establish flatness and parallelism.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer surface & edge grinding
description: Grinding of wafer faces and edge profiling.
purpose: Achieve thickness targets and a robust edge profile.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer polishing
description: Chemical-mechanical polishing of the bare wafer (often double-side) to a mirror finish.
purpose: Deliver the flatness and surface roughness required for device processing.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Final wafer cleaning
description: Wet cleaning of polished wafers before packing.
purpose: Remove particles, metals and organics from prime wafers.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Bare-wafer inspection
description: Inspection and geometry measurement of incoming or outgoing bare wafers.
purpose: Qualify wafer geometry and surface defectivity.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Epitaxy
description: Growth of a single-crystal film on a single-crystal substrate, e.g. Si or SiC homo-epitaxy, or GaN/GaAs/InP compound layers by MOCVD or MBE.
purpose: Create layers with controlled doping, composition and thickness that the substrate alone cannot provide.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer cleaning
description: Removal of particles, organic and metallic contaminants and native oxide, by wet (batch or single-wafer) or dry/plasma methods. Repeated many times in the flow.
purpose: Keep surfaces free of contaminants that cause yield loss.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Oxidation
description: Thermal growth of silicon dioxide by exposing silicon to oxygen or steam at high temperature.
purpose: Form gate, field or masking oxides.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Diffusion
description: High-temperature redistribution of dopants in a furnace.
purpose: Form junctions and wells.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Deposition (thin films)
description: Addition of dielectric, semiconductor or metal films by chemical (CVD, ALD) or physical (PVD) methods.
purpose: Build the device and interconnect layer stack.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Chemical vapour deposition (CVD)
description: Film formation from gas-phase precursors reacting at or near the wafer surface, thermally or plasma-enhanced.
purpose: Deposit conformal dielectric and conductive films.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Atomic layer deposition (ALD)
description: Self-limiting, sequential surface reactions that deposit films one atomic layer per cycle.
purpose: Deposit ultra-thin, highly conformal films (high-k, liners, spacers).
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Physical vapour deposition (PVD)
description: Deposition of metal or compound films by sputtering a target or evaporating a source in vacuum.
purpose: Form barrier, seed and metal layers.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Photoresist coat & bake
description: Spin-coating of photoresist and associated bake steps on a coater/developer track linked to the scanner.
purpose: Apply a uniform radiation-sensitive film for patterning.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Lithography (exposure)
description: Transfer of the mask (reticle) pattern into the resist by projection exposure (EUV, DUV/ArF, KrF, i-line), direct write (e-beam, laser) or nanoimprint.
purpose: Define circuit patterns at the required resolution and overlay.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Develop
description: Post-exposure bake and dissolution of exposed (or unexposed) resist.
purpose: Reveal the resist pattern.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Etch
description: Selective removal of material through the resist mask, by plasma (dry) or chemical (wet) etching.
purpose: Transfer the pattern into the underlying film or substrate.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Ash / resist strip
description: Removal of residual photoresist by oxygen plasma (ashing) or wet strippers.
purpose: Clear resist after etch or implant.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Ion implantation
description: Acceleration of dopant ions into the wafer at controlled energy and dose.
purpose: Introduce dopants to form wells, sources/drains and junctions.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Annealing / RTP
description: Thermal treatment to activate dopants and repair damage, in furnaces, rapid thermal processors or with laser (millisecond/nanosecond) annealing.
purpose: Activate dopants and control diffusion within a thermal budget.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Chemical mechanical planarisation (CMP)
description: Combined chemical and mechanical polishing to planarise dielectric and metal layers.
purpose: Provide planar surfaces for subsequent lithography and remove overburden.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Metallisation & plating
description: Formation of interconnect metal, typically barrier/seed by PVD then copper electroplating (damascene).
purpose: Build the multilevel wiring.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Metrology
description: Measurement of film thickness, critical dimensions, overlay and surface properties.
purpose: Monitor and control process steps.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Defect inspection & review
description: Detection, classification and review of defects on patterned and unpatterned wafers (optical, e-beam).
purpose: Find yield-limiting defects early.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Mask / reticle making
description: Writing, inspecting, repairing and qualifying photomasks and reticles.
purpose: Produce defect-free masks for lithography.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer probe & electrical test
description: Electrical testing of each die on the wafer using a prober, probe card and automated test equipment.
purpose: Identify good dies before assembly (known-good die).
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Back-grinding / wafer thinning
description: Grinding and stress-relief polishing of the wafer backside to the target thickness.
purpose: Reduce package height and enable stacking.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer mounting
description: Laminating the wafer onto dicing tape on a frame.
purpose: Hold dies in place during and after dicing.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Dicing
description: Separation of the wafer into individual dies by blade sawing, laser ablation, stealth (internal) laser modification or plasma etching.
purpose: Singulate dies with minimal chipping and kerf.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Die attach
description: Pick-and-place of dies onto a leadframe or substrate using adhesive, solder or sinter materials.
purpose: Mechanically and thermally attach the die.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wire bonding
description: Connection of die pads to package leads with fine gold, copper or aluminium wire (ball or wedge bonding).
purpose: Provide electrical interconnect.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Flip-chip bonding
description: Face-down attachment of bumped dies to a substrate by mass reflow or thermo-compression bonding.
purpose: Area-array interconnect with short electrical paths.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Molding / encapsulation
description: Encapsulation of assemblies with epoxy molding compound (transfer or compression molding) and dispensing of underfill.
purpose: Protect the die and interconnect.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Lead plating & finishing
description: Plating of external leads for solderability.
purpose: Ensure board-level solderability.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Marking
description: Laser (or ink) marking of packages, strips or wafers with identifiers.
purpose: Provide traceability and product identification.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Package singulation
description: Sawing, punching or laser cutting of molded strips into individual packages.
purpose: Separate finished packages.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Package inspection
description: Automated optical and X-ray inspection of packages for mechanical and internal defects.
purpose: Screen out assembly defects.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Final / package test
description: Electrical test of packaged devices with ATE and handlers, across temperature where required.
purpose: Guarantee shipped-product quality and bin by performance.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Burn-in & reliability
description: Stressing devices at elevated voltage and temperature to screen early-life failures.
purpose: Remove infant-mortality failures.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Through-silicon via (TSV)
description: Vertical vias etched through silicon, lined, filled with metal and revealed from the backside.
purpose: Vertical interconnect for 3D stacks and interposers.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Through-glass via (TGV) & glass core
description: Formation of vias in glass substrates or interposers, commonly by laser modification followed by wet etching, or by laser drilling.
purpose: Enable glass-core substrates and glass interposers.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Redistribution layer (RDL)
description: Thin-film wiring layers (polymer dielectric + plated copper) that re-route die I/O.
purpose: Fan in/out interconnect at wafer or panel level.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Wafer-level packaging (fan-in)
description: Packaging performed on the whole wafer before singulation, with I/O within the die footprint.
purpose: Chip-scale packages with minimal footprint.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Fan-out wafer/panel-level packaging
description: Dies embedded in a reconstituted wafer or panel with RDL extending beyond the die edge.
purpose: Higher I/O density without a substrate.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: 2.5D integration (interposer)
description: Side-by-side placement of dies on a silicon, organic or glass interposer or bridge.
purpose: High-bandwidth die-to-die connectivity (e.g. logic + HBM).
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: 3D stacking & HBM
description: Vertical stacking of dies (e.g. DRAM stacks for HBM) connected by TSVs and microbumps or direct/hybrid bonds.
purpose: Increase bandwidth and density per footprint.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Chiplet integration
description: Assembly of multiple smaller dies (chiplets) into one package via 2.5D/3D or advanced substrates.
purpose: Heterogeneous integration and yield improvement.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Hybrid / direct bonding
description: Bonding of dies or wafers through direct dielectric-dielectric and Cu-Cu contact without solder.
purpose: Sub-10 µm pitch interconnect for 3D integration.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Temporary bond / debond
description: Temporary attachment of thin wafers to carriers and later release (e.g. by laser debonding).
purpose: Handle thin wafers through backside processing.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Advanced substrate & panel processing
description: Build-up substrate and panel-level processes: via drilling, lithography and plating on large-format panels.
purpose: High-density substrates for large packages.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Laser lift-off
description: Separation of a film or device layer from a transparent carrier by laser absorption at the interface.
purpose: Release flexible displays or MicroLEDs from growth/carrier substrates.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Laser annealing (LTPS / display)
description: Laser crystallisation of amorphous silicon into polysilicon for display backplanes.
purpose: High-mobility thin-film transistors.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: MicroLED mass transfer & repair
description: Transfer of large numbers of MicroLED dies to the backplane and repair of defective pixels.
purpose: Assemble MicroLED displays.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Automated material handling
description: Overhead hoist transport, stockers and vehicles that move FOUPs between tools.
purpose: Deliver wafers to tools without manual handling.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Tool automation & wafer handling
description: EFEMs, wafer robots, load ports and factory software linking tools to the fab.
purpose: Automated, contamination-free wafer transfer and tool control.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Vacuum & abatement (subfab)
description: Dry, turbo and cryo pumps creating process vacuum, and abatement systems that treat process exhaust.
purpose: Maintain process vacuum and destroy hazardous or greenhouse exhaust gases.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Gas & chemical delivery
description: Gas cabinets, valve manifold boxes, bulk gas and chemical distribution that feed tools.
purpose: Deliver pure, controlled process fluids safely.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)

name: Utilities (UPW, CDA, cooling, power)
description: Ultrapure water, clean dry air, process cooling, waste treatment, power distribution and facility monitoring.
purpose: Provide the utilities every tool depends on.
content_basis: Editorial reference (generic process description; not source-traced)
